project: Wuxia Life P58 Town Apprentice Merchant-Magnate Bridge
description: Close the bounded runtime bridge from the existing town_apprentice ordinary-growth path into the current merchant_magnate mixed gate and P55 magnate chain, without reopening sample lines, expanding into a full merchant wave, or broadening to other ordinary origins.

userStories.title: Audit apprentice-to-magnate bridge gap
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of the current town_apprentice to merchant_magnate evidence chain so P58 closes the real bridge gap instead of rebuilding P55 or P56.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize current apprentice ordinary-growth signals, mixed-fixture evidence, and magnate gate requirements
Separate existing merchant_magnate proof from missing apprentice runtime bridge layers
Save docs/test-reports/p58-town-apprentice-merchant-bridge-gap-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Read-only audit. Created gap audit doc mapping apprentice signals vs merchant gate requirements.

userStories.title: Lock P58 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract for P58 so the stage stays focused on a single high-value bridge instead of sprawling into general merchant or ordinary expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit the stage to town_apprentice to merchant_magnate only
Define allowed layers: configuration wiring, light presentation, targeted simulation or verification, narrow regression
List forbidden expansions: sample-line work, peasant or tavern bridge work, full merchant wave, platformization
Save docs/test-reports/p58-town-apprentice-merchant-bridge-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract story. Created scope contract doc with allowed/forbidden boundaries.

userStories.title: Define apprentice bridge contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded contract for how apprentice trade-network signals graduate into the existing wealth-route and magnate chain.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a minimal apprentice prerequisite group using existing trade-curiosity or partnership signals
Define at least one ordinary-to-merchant bridge checkpoint
Explain how the bridge connects to route_wealth_committed or an equivalent existing wealth-route gate
Keep ordinary identity intact before the bridge checkpoint fires
userStories.notes: Design story. Created bridge contract doc with prerequisite group, checkpoint, and downstream flow.

userStories.title: Define apprentice magnate-entry contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a clear contract for when the bridged apprentice path should count as entering the current magnate chain instead of remaining generic merchant flavor.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the minimum additional conditions required for the apprentice path to enter the P55 magnate on-ramp
Document the distinction versus a generic merchant start
Document the reuse boundary versus existing P55 pressure and payoff nodes
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix
userStories.notes: Design story. Created magnate-entry contract doc with conditions, distinction, and reuse boundary.

userStories.title: Wire apprentice-to-merchant configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the apprentice bridge wired through existing JSON carriers so the path becomes runtime-reachable without a new framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the bridge only through existing ordinary, merchant, or wealth-route configuration carriers
Do not introduce a new origin or merchant framework
The bridged path can trigger the existing magnate gate chain or an equivalent bounded proof
Existing P25, P55, and P56 evidence does not regress
userStories.notes: Configuration story. Added route_wealth_committed and apprentice_merchant_bridge_crossed to join_partnership flags in midlife JSON.

userStories.title: Add apprentice bridge player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the apprentice route to visibly read as crossing from skilled town worker into merchant ascent so the bridge is legible.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least two readable apprentice-to-merchant bridge signals on existing expression surfaces
Keep the wording distinct from ordinary apprentice midlife text and from the later magnate-stage text
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests
userStories.notes: Expression story. Added bridge expression in currentGoal, lifeMemory, and summary surfaces.

userStories.title: Add targeted apprentice-to-magnate proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof showing that town_apprentice can reach the current magnate chain without relying only on static mixed-fixture shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one targeted simulation, replay, or verification artifact
Show apprentice seed, bridge flag, and magnate checkpoint evidence in order
Do not rely on direct terminal mixed-flag seeding as the only proof path
Do not require combinatorial exhaust or a full lifetime platform wave
userStories.notes: Proof story. Created targeted proof artifact with flag chain trace and gate evaluation.

userStories.title: Add narrow apprentice-bridge regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests for the apprentice bridge so future edits do not silently break the path or collapse it back into fixture-only proof.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover bridge gating, player-facing expression, and targeted proof with narrow assertions
Reuse existing P25, P55, and P56 harnesses
Do not rewrite the full merchant or ordinary test suites
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P58 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a P58 closure report stating exactly what runtime bridge now exists between town_apprentice and merchant_magnate, and what remains deferred for later merchant or ordinary waves.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p58-town-apprentice-merchant-bridge-closure-report.md
Summarize configuration, expression, simulation or verification, and test evidence
State the boundary versus P55 merchant deepening, P56 ordinary growth, and the closed sample-line track
List larger merchant or ordinary follow-up items that remain deferred
